runyth-compendium.summary: What the Compendium ships, how it stays system-agnostic, and where the licence lives.

text.content:
The Compendium in any world

Runyth Compendium is a content library for Foundry Virtual Tabletop. Its packs are system-agnostic: they install and open in any world, whatever the game system underneath offers. Armory and Features carry Item documents without system-specific data; importing one gives your world's system a clean document to fill. World Elements are journal text; Tables are roll tables.

System-agnostic means deliberate: records carry no system block at all. A companion module, such as a D&D 5e 2024 companion, gives selected records real system fields with its own tested release.

Licence per record

Every record in the Compendium is original Runyth homebrew content and is released under CC BY-SA 4.0. The licence is stamped on each record under the module's flags (contentLicence), and the text files in packs/_source carry the same statement. The module's source code around the content is AGPL-3.0-or-later; see LICENSE.

When you excerpt or adapt a record for your campaigns, share alike and attribute Runyth as the content's source.

Growing the Compendium

Records are authored as JSON under packs/_source and compiled by the repository tooling into deterministic NeDB packs, with a content hash stamped on each record. New records follow the naming and ID rules in this chapter's siblings, and every release of the Compendium publishes the whole set together.
